clips.title: The story
paras: In Darnassus, young night elf druids learn to reach Moonglade. Mathrengyl Bearwalker teaches novices a spell to carry themselves across the world into Moonglade, where they meet Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven. There begins their path toward mastering bear form.

Moonglade is an ancient sanctuary apart from the rest of Azeroth, devoted to the teachings of Cenarius. Keeper Remulos watches over its groves, where druids find peace and communion with nature. Young druids learn a spell that lets them carry themselves across the world into Moonglade, reaching a heart of druidic wisdom beyond mortal distances.

Moonglade welcomes all who follow the wild, though the Cenarion Circle knows its share of tension. In Darnassus, Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm and Keeper Remulos disagree over nature’s care and the creation of Teldrassil. Their differences do not close Nighthaven to young acolytes, who are welcomed to pursue their studies.

In Nighthaven, Dendrite Starblaze guides young druids in the ways of the Claw. Before an initiate can take up the bear’s mantle, the trials teach the bear’s endurance, fury, and defense of the wild. Starblaze welcomes each student in reverence to Father Cenarius as the trials of the Great Bear Spirit begin.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: All druids are welcome in the sacred lands of Moonglade, regardless of the current tensions in the Cenarion Circle between Arch Druid Staghelm and Keeper Remulos - Moonglade's guardian. Now that you're learning the ways of the Claw, I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there. Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace.
As for your first lesson, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on. Good luck, young druid.

clips.title: Completion
paras: And so it begins, Father Cenarius. And so it begins.
Dendrite makes a quick, invisible gesture in the air above him. A slight aura of power falls over him.

The first perspective of nature you must adapt to is that of the bear. I will put you on the path to understanding this aspect of druidic life, but it is you that must embrace it and propagate it - now and forever!
